plainText:
Masayuki Katō (Japanese: 加藤将之 Katō Masayuki) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Katō was born on September 23, 1972, in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the during , where his only role was Porter, a group of cruise ship guides in the Decolore Islands. Katō was once affiliated with Mausu Promotion, and is currently affiliated with Ken Production.
